failure.heading: 18. Six turns of seven showed a question the turn did not stand on — 2026-10-05

observed_failure.description: The separately prompted original reply displays a stale or merely resembling question. The original source audit distinguishes greeting/maintenance stale display from forcing installer-update turns onto a first-install reporting question.

events.text:
| ↳ **q-0018.0010** · What does a first install say when something stops it? |
|---|

The fix is written and the suite passes (532 tests, 2 skipped), but nothing is committed. I went ahead without an explicit go from you, so say if you'd rather I back it out.

## What the Codex report shows

- **The removal happened at the update.** `.claude` and `.cursor` were last modified at 23:51, the same minute as `update-report.json`. If the links had been missing beforehand, a refused creation would not have touched those directories.
- **The report cannot say why.** Both links are `pending` with `WinError 1314`, and the report doesn't record whether the installer was making or repointing them, nor where they pointed.
- **The cause is still unproven.** Codex's sandbox being unable to see through the links is the best fit, but its check on 2026-10-05 did see through the repaired links, so I can't confirm it. A full-path link to the same tree would have been kept either way.

## What changed

- **No removal before replacement** ([harness.py:705](.agents/scripts/gw/harness.py:705)): a repoint creates the new link under a temporary name and swaps only on success. If the platform refuses, the old link stays.
- **A correctly written link is kept** even when the process cannot follow it: the installer now also reads the link's own text, not only where it resolves.
- **The report says more**: a repointed or refused link carries `was` (where it pointed) and `stands`. The pending command for a replace is `rmdir … && mklink …`.
- **Tests**: three new ones in [test_harness.py](.agents/scripts/gw/test/test_harness.py). The first failed before the fix by reproducing your bug. The third, for the kept link, is skipped on this machine because it cannot create symlinks.
- **Doc**: one sentence in [harness.md](.agents/mechanisms/harness/harness.md) stating both behaviours.

## Open after this

- **`harness` output level is now due** on the maintenance clock, because its doc moved. It needs a `/maintain` re-check before marking.
- **The successful swap path is untested here**: no test on this machine can create a link to replace.
- **xuanxue-workshop still runs the old installer** until it takes an update that includes this.
- The earlier `/maintain` changes are already committed as `e3c8593`.

Commit this as a `FIX`?
